sloka: शासितस्त्वं सखित्वेन कार्यं ते मम शासनम् ।प्रजाः संरक्ष धर्मेण नोत्तरं वक्तुमर्हसि ।। ७.१०८.२९ ॥
transliteration: śāsitastvaṁ sakhitvena kāryaṁ te mama śāsanam ।prajāḥ saṁrakṣa dharmeṇa nottaraṁ vaktumarhasi ।। 7.108.29 ॥

translations.english: Rama instructed Vibhishana as a friend that he must obey Rama's command to protect his subjects righteously, and he should not offer any counter-argument.
